direction.above: Measurements disagree more than the declared precision allows
direction.below: The adjustment fits better than the declared precision

explain.above: Look for a blunder, a moved reference or an omitted correction before touching weights.
explain.below: The stated sigmas are pessimistic for this data. Nothing indicates a measurement problem.
explain.within: The residuals match the precision you declared.

warning.inflatedSigmas: Sigmas were multiplied, which makes any test easier to pass.
warning.manyExclusions: More than a tenth of the measurement components are excluded.
warning.freedReferences: References were freed, so the datum changed.
warning.lowRedundancy: Almost no redundancy: the geometry cannot check itself.
warning.fitsBetterThanDeclared: The fit is better than declared precision, so the test proves little.

save.description: Creates one complete draft from the selected trial. The original version, historical runs and raw observations stay immutable.
